findings.title: A resumed run whose compound notes dedupe as skipped never names compound.md to the commit
findings.description: notesPath is set only when appendNotes appended at least one row. A run that appended its rows, halted before its manifest persisted and was resumed sees every row deduped as skipped, so manifest.notesPath stays null and the commit briefing never names docs/notes/compound.md, which the first attempt left modified in the working tree.
findings.suggestion: Also set notesPath when rows were skipped and the table already holds a row whose source is this run id.

findings.title: A throw from deriveNotes aborts the review adjudication
findings.description: deriveNotes and appendNotes run inline in adjudicateReview, so a malformed notes table makes appendNotes throw and the whole review adjudication fails with it.
findings.suggestion: Isolate the notes write from adjudication.

findings.title: Recorded policy banners are matched on their prefix up to the first colon
findings.description: adjudicateReview drops a policy banner when any recorded banner shares its text up to the first colon, so a second, different banner under the same prefix (a later base, a new problem) is never spoken.
findings.suggestion: Compare whole banners, or key them by an id.
